rationale: The agent performed multiple write actions (returns and a pending item modification) without an explicit user confirmation step, violating the policy requirement to confirm before any order-changing write. The returns also appear inconsistent with the user’s request: two items were returned from the same order (#W6239298) even though the user specified the bookshelf and jigsaw were from different orders, and it’s unclear the backpack return was processed from the order that also contained the vacuum cleaner as requested. The user also asked to change the shipping address to their default Chicago home, but there is no action indicating the address was updated. Finally, the user requested a tracking number for a cancelled order; the correct response is that cancelled orders do not have tracking numbers, but the conversation shows no such clarification or tracking info provided. While the agent did look up the user by email and retrieve order details, the core requests were not completed in-policy, so this fails the pass bar.
